words.sceneBrief: Sami sits within the clearly visible cool shadow cast by a leafy tree on sunny ground.
Layla slides a folded letter into an open paper envelope; the envelope flap is visible.
Rear three-quarter view of Sami wearing a school backpack across his back.
words.phonicsNoteAr: الظَّاءُ مَفْتُوحَةٌ: ظَ. ظَهْرٌ هُوَ الْجُزْءُ الْخَلْفِيُّ مِنَ الْجِسْمِ.

words.sceneBrief: Close view of a mother carefully trimming one of Sami's fingernails with a nail clipper.
A slender gazelle with curved horns runs between widely spaced trees.
A single lamp casts a warm pool of light inside an otherwise dark room.
Sami and Layla eat lunch at a table while a high sun and a clock with both hands at twelve indicate noon.
words.phonicsNoteAr: الظَّاءُ مَضْمُومَةٌ: ظُ. ظُهْرٌ وَقْتٌ فِي مُنْتَصَفِ النَّهَارِ.

words.sceneBrief: After running Sami drinks eagerly from a water bottle, with a ball and sunny park behind him.
Layla holds an open umbrella above her head while rain falls outside its dry sheltered area.
Sami wears clear-lens eyeglasses while looking at an open book.
A friendly dog holds a clean cartoon bone in its mouth on a lawn.
A freshly washed spotless shirt hangs on a drying line beside a laundry basket.
Sami places plain coins into an open wallet, its coin compartment clearly visible.
A station clerk behind a counter hands a plain ticket to Sami.
Sami stands beside a tidy desk with books stacked neatly and pencils sorted in a holder.
A thick braided rope forms a broad coil beside a much thinner thread for a clear thickness comparison.
Sami looks upward at a large moon in a clear evening sky, his gaze visibly directed toward it.
Sami waits safely on the pavement at a bus stop with a bus approaching in the background.
Sami wakes and sits up in bed as the rising sun first appears at the window; his eyes open and arms stretch.
words.phonicsNoteAr: الظَّاءُ فِي آخِرِ الْكَلِمَةِ بَعْدَ الْأَلِفِ؛ تَظْهَرُ مُنْفَصِلَةً: ظ.

words.sceneBrief: Sami recites a short song from memory with his eyes away from a songbook and one hand keeping the rhythm.

microstories.title: الْمِظَلَّةُ
sentences: يَنْظُرُ سَامِي إِلَى الْمَطَرِ مِنَ النَّافِذَةِ.
sceneBriefs: Sami wakes in bed as gray rainy morning light enters the window.
Sami stands indoors looking through the window at falling rain.
At the doorway Layla hands a folded umbrella to Sami.
Sami waits dry beneath the open umbrella at a bus stop while rain falls.

microstories.title: اِسْتِرَاحَةٌ فِي الظِّلِّ
sentences: يَنْظُرُ سَامِي إِلَى كَلْبٍ يَحْمِلُ عَظْمًا.
sceneBriefs: Sami runs across a sunny garden toward a tree casting a clear shadow.
Sami stops beside the tree and drinks from his water bottle.
Sami rests seated within the shade of the same tree.
From the shade Sami watches a friendly dog walk by carrying a bone.
